senses.gloss:
कौम कौम, अम्, n., N. of a Vedic treatise,
so named from its author.

कौमार कौमार, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुमार or
कुमारी), juvenile, youthful, girlish, belonging to a
youth or young girl, maiden, maidenly, virgin, (कौ-
मारी भार्या, a virgin wife, one who has not had a
husband previously; कौमारः पतिः, a man who
[]
marries a virgin; कौमारं व्रतम्, a vow of
abstinence); soft, tender; relating to the god of
war or Sanat-kumāra, belonging or peculiar to them;
(ई), f. one of the seven divine Mātṛs, the divine
mothers or personified energies of the gods, the
energy or शक्ति of Kumāra or Kārttikeya the god of
war; a kind of bulbous plant, = वाराही-कन्द; (अम्),
n. childhood, youth from birth to the age of five;
maidenhood to the age of sixteen.
—कौमार-
पर्वत, अस्, m., N. of a mountain.
—कौमार-
भृत्य, अम्, n. the rearing and education of chil-
dren, a department of medical science; [cf. कुमार-
भृत्या.]
—कौमारराज्य, अम्, n. (fr. कुमार-
राज = राज-कुमार, युव-राज), the position of
an heir-apparent; [cf. यौवराज्य.]
कौमारक, अम्, n. childhood, the juvenile age.

कौमारिक, अस्, ई, अम्, endowed with girls;
(अस्), m. a father of girls.
—कौमारिक-तन्त्र, अम्,
n., N. of a Tantra.

कौमुद कौमुद, अस्, m. (fr. कुमुद), the
month Kārttika, October-November; (ई), f. moon-
light, moonshine (from its causing the Kumudas to
blossom); elucidation, (the word Kaumudī being
metaphorically used like other words of similar im-
port (चन्द्रिका) at the end of the title of grammatical
commentaries and other explanatory works to imply
that the book so designated throws much light on
the subject of which it treats, e. g. पदार्थ-कौ-
मुदी, प्रक्रिया-क्˚, लघु-क्˚, वैषम्य-क्˚, सिद्-
धान्त-क्˚); the day of full moon in the month
Kārttika, sacred to the god Kārttikeya; the day of
full moon in the month Āśvina; a festival in honour
of Kārttikeya held on the full moon of the month
Kārttika; a festival in general; N. of a metre con-
sisting of two lines of twenty-four syllables each; N.
of a river.
—कौमुदी-चार, अस्, अम्, m. n. the day
of full moon in the month Āśvina.
—कौमुदी-
पति, इस्, m. the moon.
—कौमुदी-वृक्ष, अस्,
m. the stick or stand of a lamp.

कौमुदिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to a water-lily,
abounding with them; (इका), f., N. of a female
friend of Umā.

कौमोदकी कौमोदकी, f. (fr. कुमोदक),
N. of the club or mace of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa, given
to him by Varuṇa.
कौमोदी, f. the club or mace of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa.

कौम्भ कौम्भ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुम्भ), put
into a pot.

कौम्भकारि, इस्, m. or कौम्भकार्य, अस्, m.
the son of a potter.
